goal: Bring the public gateway state to a compliant next step while preserving token bucket invariants and the admission audit trail.

runtime.algorithm: Discrete token bucket: on each request at time t, tokens = min(capacity, tokens + rate*(t - last_t)); a request of size s is admitted iff tokens >= s, consuming s tokens, otherwise it is dropped.
runtime.metering: per-request token accounting, refill at integer request times only

pending_decision.question: How many of the 9 requests in the audit window are admitted by the token bucket (capacity 8, refill 2 tokens/s, window 0..34 s)?
pending_decision.controller_note: The rate-limit controller is blocked until the admission count is verified.
